verdict.rationale: Granola's docs confirm AI-generated meeting summaries with customizable templates for different call types (1:1s, interviews, sales pitches) and note structure derived from transcripts, plus Chat/API features to surface insights and draft follow-ups. However, no evidence explicitly describes a standardized 'key points / decisions / next steps' summary format, and a hands-on PM (granola-comm-7) built a separate kanban app because action items 'tend to slip through' the notes, indicating summaries may need supplementation rather than being share-ready out of the box. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a decisions/next-steps summary structure, and independent confirmation that PMs share summaries unedited.
